manifest.name: @mokuyoaxis/agent-guard
manifest.description: Harness-neutral reliability infrastructure for AI coding agents: recoverable destructive actions, disclosure checks, controlled synthetic behaviour experiments, and a shared Core with optional native adapters.

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover tests -v && node tests/test_dsh_adapter.mjs && node tests/test_dsh_read_result.mjs

bundle.text:
# agent-guard - bundle patch layer.
#
# Appends one composition row to the launcher composition: registers the
# agent_guard_safe_delete / agent_guard_restore / agent_guard_status model
# tools, a PreToolUse-style interception on the bash entry (via the
# tools/pre-execute waterfall), and prompt guidance. The decision rules
# themselves live in ONE Python core (skills/delete-guard/scripts/check.py)
# shipped inside this package - this adapter never re-implements them.
#
# config:
#   repoRoot      empty = resolve Python core from this package (default).
#                 Set an absolute path to point at a live agent-guard
#                 checkout instead (development mode).
#   defaultCwd    empty = executor default (the session workspace).
#   promptSection register the deletion-discipline system-prompt section.
#   sectionOrder  ascending; persona is 0, tool guidance conventionally
#                 100-199.
#   dialect       shell dialect the session issues commands in: posix
#                 (default), cmd, or powershell. Callers may also set it
#                 per call (tools) or via AGENT_GUARD_DIALECT; an unusable
#                 value is refused by the guard with an explicit BLOCK code.
- insert:
    - id: agent_guard
      name: '@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard'
      config:
        repoRoot: ''
        defaultCwd: ''
        promptSection: true
        sectionOrder: 105
        dialect: ''

**Make destructive agent actions reversible by default.** · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Agent Guard preserves recovery data before supported destructive actions,
checks text before sending it, and provides a Lab for testing agent and host
behaviour. The shared Python Core can be called through command-line tools
or host adapters.

**AI agents setting up this project:** Before changing configuration or writing
a bridge, read the [integration requirements](adapters/INTEGRATION.md), then
the [setup workflow](docs/guides/getting-started.md#set-up-a-coding-agent) and
the matching adapter guide. Check your actual host/version and its official
hook documentation, verify the integration, and report the observed coverage.
Installed Skills or copied configuration alone do not establish protection.

We currently focus on **DSH and Kimi Code** integrations. For other hosts,
ask the official coding agent to configure Agent Guard locally.

This documentation covers [0.2.7](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.7.md), adding
Cleanup plans, deletion admission limits and optional local MCP tools.
Check the exact-version release channels below before installing.

| Capability | What it helps you do | Entry |
|---|---|---|
| **Recovery protection** | Relocate valuable files before deletion; snapshot tracked state before supported Git overwrites; inspect and restore transactions | [delete-guard](skills/delete-guard/SKILL.md) |
| **Cleanup proposals (0.2.7)** | Review classified workspace candidates, sizes and effects; explicitly confirm selected targets before safe_delete | [Cleanup Copilot](docs/guides/cleanup-plan.md) |
| **Deletion limits (0.2.7)** | Inspect shared protected paths, persistent budgets, rate/repeat limits and large-batch confirmation | [Limits and recovery](docs/guides/deletion-limits.md) |
| **Local MCP tools (0.2.7)** | Call safe_delete, ordinary restore, transaction/status queries and GC preview from a supporting client | [MCP setup](docs/guides/mcp.md) |
| **Disclosure checks** | Detect supported credentials and host-identifying paths; apply a redaction plan or withhold a payload | [exfil-guard](skills/exfil-guard/SKILL.md) |
| **Behaviour experiments** | Calibrate an observer, test a declared exposure channel, then compare matched guard-off/on trials | [guard-lab](docs/lab/guard-lab.md) |

A Skill supplies instructions; it does not intercept tool calls. Automatic
protection depends on an active, compatible host hook and its covered tools.
The optional local MCP adapter provides explicit tools and does not intercept
actions that bypass them; its SDK installation is separate from the Core.
Agent Guard is not an OS sandbox against a malicious process with equal
privileges. The [capability matrix](docs/guides/harness-capabilities.md)
states the observed coverage and gaps.

guard-lab is a **user-controlled experiment tool**. It puts non-secret,
synthetic markers and harmless bait into a disposable project and observes
only declared channels. The real controller and evidence stay outside the
fixture given to the tested agent.

Its workflow separates three questions:

1. **Calibrate:** do the observer, markers, scans and evidence chain work?
   Built-in controls call no model and make no external-network request.
2. **Observe exposure:** does an unguarded real-harness trial trigger the
   selected channel?
3. **Compare protection:** after an effective baseline, does a matched
   guarded trial reduce or block that exposure?

Start with one zero-model control from the package or checkout root:

```sh
lab_run="$(mktemp -d)"
python3 guard_lab.py run --case clean --output-dir "$lab_run/clean" --json
```

The other controls are `mock-positive`, `mock-injection` and
`snapshot-positive`. Run all four before a real-harness experiment, following
the [Lab guide](docs/lab/guard-lab.md). Installed packages also expose
`agent-guard-lab`.

A control PASS means **instrument calibration**, not model safety.
An unhealthy observer or missing evidence is `INCONCLUSIVE`; a quiet
guard-off baseline cannot establish mitigation. Matched comparisons require
the same relevant harness/version/model, task, protocol and non-guard
configuration. Lab results cover the declared channels, not every file read,
external transfer or model request. Existing
[Kimi](docs/reports/test-report-kimi-guard-lab.md) and
[DSH](docs/reports/test-report-dsh-guard-lab.md) reports retain their bounded
results, failures and review states.

Since RC3, the package includes [blue-team research](docs/research/README.md), a
[sanitized experiment report](docs/reports/blue-team-lab-2026-10.md) and a
[portable four-control example](docs/lab/blue-team-calibration.md).
The research covers provenance, disclosure permissions and task utility in
bounded private experiments; those methods do not extend production hook
coverage. Lab proceeds gradually. Forks, PRs and independent defensive
reproductions are welcome; preserve failed and inconclusive results.

From a checkout or package containing the example, run all four existing controls: ```sh blue_run="$(mktemp -d)" python3 docs/lab/examples/blue-team-calibration.py --output-dir "$blue_run/controls" ``` This example calls no model; its summary describes instrument calibration.

Python 3.9+ and Git are required for the Core. The examples use a POSIX shell;
native bridges and optional capture helpers have their own requirements.
The optional MCP adapter requires Python 3.10+ and a separately installed
[pinned SDK](docs/guides/mcp.md).

| Version | Status |
|---|---|
| [0.2.7](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.7.md) | Version documented here; verify exact-version availability below |
| [0.2.6](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.6.md) | Earlier published release with Kimi feedback and host compatibility updates |
| [0.2.5](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.5.md) | Earlier stable release |
| [0.2.4](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.4.md) | Earlier stable release |
| [0.2.4-hotfix.1](https://github.com/mokuyoaxis/agent-guard/releases/tag/0.2.4-hotfix.1) | Opt-in quarantine protection backport; npm `hotfix` |
| [0.2.5-rc3](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.5-rc3.md) | Published prerelease, including RC1/RC2 maintenance; npm `rc` |

Before installing 0.2.7, confirm availability through its exact
[GitHub release](https://github.com/mokuyoaxis/agent-guard/releases/tag/0.2.7)
and [npm version](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard/v/0.2.7).
A checkout or manifest alone does not establish package availability.

If that version is unavailable, use reviewed source or a locally built
tarball following the [version notes](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.7.md).
Versioned tests and package checks are recorded separately from the historical
0.2.6-metadata source results. Existing successful deletes can newly be
refused by the [admission limits](docs/guides/deletion-limits.md).

Once the exact version is available, install to a chosen, stable user-owned prefix:

```sh
npm install --prefix /absolute/path/to/agent-guard-install @mokuyoaxis/agent-guard@0.2.7
```

The package root is
`/absolute/path/to/agent-guard-install/node_modules/@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard`.
The exact scoped package name matters. A source checkout is also usable:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mokuyoaxis/agent-guard.git
cd agent-guard
```

To select the published prerelease, use `@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard@0.2.5-rc3`.
The [GitHub release](https://github.com/mokuyoaxis/agent-guard/releases/tag/0.2.5-rc3)
and [npm version](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard/v/0.2.5-rc3)
identify that package. For only the stable-line quarantine protection fix,
select `@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard@0.2.4-hotfix.1` explicitly. Neither channel
replaces stable `latest`.

Version [0.2.6](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.6.md) builds on 0.2.5 with
optional Kimi Stop recovery feedback, separate Stop doctor checks, DSH Lab
preflight diagnostics, DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4` default deletion support and the
Kimi `2.3.0` Bash profile. Existing installations need an upgrade to acquire
these additions; Stop also needs explicit configuration. See
[setup and the agent setup prompt](docs/guides/getting-started.md) and the
[0.2.6 version details](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.6.md).

From the workspace being protected, point at your package/checkout root:

```sh
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/safe_delete.py src/old_module.py --dry-run
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/safe_delete.py src/old_module.py
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/restore.py list
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/restore.py '<txid>'

Valuable targets are relocated with exact recovery paths in a manifest.
Provably regenerable, Git-ignored artifacts may be deleted directly.
Supported Git overwrites snapshot tracked state; hard-reset collisions with
untracked/ignored content are refused. Force restore preserves the current
occupant before replacement. Errors can leave partial work: inspect the
reported transaction IDs, filesystem and state before retrying.

Version 0.2.5 makes these results explicit:
quarantined data still occupies storage, GC is manual, and `ALLOW_NOOP`
does not certify unrecognized command effects. Local status does not prove
that a host loaded the guard. See [status and cleanup feedback](docs/guides/recovery-feedback.md).

Advisory `check.py` and `safe_delete.py --dry-run` preserve command targets but
may write quarantine/audit metadata and a Git local exclude entry. Advisory
exit 0 is not permission to execute a BLOCK or ASK.
See the [policy and assessment contract](skills/delete-guard/references/policy.md).

RC1 added quarantine control-path protection, excluded PURGED transactions
from active GC planning, and minimized restore/safe_delete audit fields.
Exact CLI/manifest recovery paths remain available. The original 0.2.4 package
lacks these changes; 0.2.4-hotfix.1 backports only quarantine control-path
protection. See the [RC notes](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.5-rc1.md).

RC2 introduced shared audit metadata projection,
uses opaque session correlation, and limits legacy status/GC metadata.
See the [audit contract and remaining boundaries](docs/guides/audit-metadata.md).
It adds observer startup diagnostics and correct cancellation accounting;
the original intermittent timeout's cause remains unknown. See the
[RC2 scope and evidence](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.5-rc2.md).

The payload owner invokes the scanner and applies its decision.
For a text file:

```sh
python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/check_span.py --channel file-write --json < draft.md
python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/sanitize.py --channel file-write < draft.md
```

A complete synthetic credential example is generated at runtime:

```sh
python3 -c 'print("config: sk-proj-" + "AbCdEf0123456789GhIjKl")' |
  python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/sanitize.py --channel file-write
```

The expected output is `config: sk-<REDACTED>`. The checker returns a
decision and plan; it never rewrites the payload. Its exit 0 means
ALLOW/SANITIZE assessment, while the sanitizer's successful stdout is the
allowed or rewritten text. ASK/BLOCK/error withholds sanitizer payload output.

Detection covers documented credential shapes, value-free secret references
and selected host paths. It is not a general repository scanner or protection
against deliberate obfuscation. The text CLIs do not automatically append
egress audit events; a trusted integration owns emission and any audit storage.
For configuration inspection, an explicit safe view reports supported
JSON/dotenv structure without scalar values; it is not an editable copy or
automatic read interception.
Read the [Skill](skills/exfil-guard/SKILL.md), [rules and exemption diagnostics](skills/exfil-guard/references/rules.md), and [channel contract](skills/exfil-guard/references/channels.md).

Ask the host's official coding agent to configure Agent Guard for the installed
version, following the [integration guide](adapters/INTEGRATION.md). Prefer a
hook that can block a tool call before it runs. We maintain the DSH and Kimi
Code integrations; other hosts use local bridges and configuration.

The results below apply to the recorded source versions, host versions and
tool paths. Other combinations need their own checks.

| Host | Integration and evidence |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | Retained reference; new version validation paused. Native Bash `PreToolUse`; sampled 2.1.270/2.1.273 scripted-host enforcement. [Setup](adapters/claude/README.md) |
| Kimi Code | Native Bash `PreToolUse`; bounded 0.42.0 root/child and 2.1.1 root-Bash observations. Version 0.2.6 adds 2.3.0 prompt/ACP root-Bash evidence with fixed responses. ASK is denied; missing/timed-out hooks remain uncovered. [Setup](adapters/kimi-code/README.md) |
| DSH | Default deletion paths on 0.1.5-rc.1/0.2.0-rc.2/0.2.1-alpha.4. Optional native read and Lab retain their two-version boundaries. [Compatibility](docs/design/dsh-compatibility.md) · [Setup](adapters/dsh/README.md) |
| Codex / other hosts | Use the official coding agent for version-specific local hook setup; verify blocking before claiming native interception. Without a blocking hook, explicit Skill/CLI remains cooperative. [Adaptation guide](adapters/INTEGRATION.md) |

Use the [full capability and evidence matrix](docs/guides/harness-capabilities.md)
for precise versions, tests and gaps. `doctor.py kimi|claude --probe` checks a
selected configuration and local adapter path; PASS does not prove a live
host loaded the hook. Drift checks are local preflight. A live sentinel is
explicit, may consume provider quota, and covers only its sampled root Bash
call. See the [host drift guide](docs/guides/host-drift.md).

The shared protocol is `ALLOW · SANITIZE · RELOCATE · SNAPSHOT · ASK · BLOCK`,
with stable reason codes and explanations.
Aggregation is `BLOCK > ASK > RELOCATE/SNAPSHOT > SANITIZE > ALLOW`.
Opaque targets and protected boundaries are refused; supported recoverable
mutations compensate before proceeding. Authorization state remains a local
discipline, not an isolated identity boundary.

|---|---|
| [Getting started](docs/guides/getting-started.md) | Package paths, agent setup prompt and safe verification |
| [Documentation index](docs/README.md) | Guides, design, Lab, reports, releases and history |
| [Architecture](docs/design/architecture.md) | Shared Core, compensation and adapter flow |
| [Threat model](docs/design/threat-model.md) | Trust assumptions and unresolved boundaries |

Bug reports, compatibility evidence, documentation fixes and focused code
changes are welcome. Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) before sharing
defensive research, independent reproductions or logs. Use
[Issues](https://github.com/mokuyoaxis/agent-guard/issues) and
[Pull Requests](https://github.com/mokuyoaxis/agent-guard/pulls); keep credentials,
private configuration and unredacted incident records out of public reports.

**让 AI Agent 的破坏性操作默认可逆。** · [English](README.md)

Agent Guard 在受支持的删除、覆盖操作前保留恢复数据，检查待外发文本中的
敏感信息，并提供 Lab 来测试 Agent 和宿主的实际行为。共享 Python Core
可通过命令行工具或宿主适配器调用。

**负责接入本项目的 AI agent：** 修改配置或编写桥接前，必须先读取
[适配要求](adapters/INTEGRATION.md)，再阅读
[接入流程](docs/guides/getting-started.md#set-up-a-coding-agent)和对应适配器指南。
确认实际宿主／版本，查阅其官方 hook 文档，完成验证后报告实际覆盖范围。
不能仅凭 Skill 已安装或配置已复制，就告诉用户防护已生效。

目前主要维护 **DSH 和 Kimi Code** 的接入。其他宿主建议交给对应的官方
编码 Agent 在本地配置。

本文档覆盖 [0.2.7](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.7.md)，新增 Cleanup 计划、
删除准入限制与可选本地 MCP 工具。安装前请通过下方精确版本渠道确认可用性。

| 能力 | 能帮助你做什么 | 入口 |
|---|---|---|
| **恢复保护** | 删除前迁移有价值的文件；受支持的 Git 覆盖前快照 tracked 状态；查询和恢复事务 | [delete-guard](skills/delete-guard/SKILL.md) |
| **清理提议（0.2.7）** | 扫描候选、分类、大小与实际执行方式；显式选择并确认后交给 safe_delete | [Cleanup Copilot](docs/guides/cleanup-plan.md) |
| **删除限制（0.2.7）** | 查询共享保护路径、持久预算、速率／重复限制与大批量确认 | [限制与恢复](docs/guides/deletion-limits.md) |
| **本地 MCP 工具（0.2.7）** | 在支持的客户端中调用 safe_delete、普通恢复、事务／状态查询和 GC 预览 | [MCP 接入](docs/guides/mcp.md) |
| **外发检测** | 检测受支持的凭据和本机标识路径；应用脱敏计划或拒绝输出 | [exfil-guard](skills/exfil-guard/SKILL.md) |
| **行为验测** | 校准观察器，验证声明信道的暴露，再比较匹配的关闭／开启防护试次 | [guard-lab](docs/lab/guard-lab.md) |

Skill 提供操作纪律，不会自行拦截工具调用。自动保护依赖宿主实际加载了 兼容 hook，且调用位于其覆盖范围内。Agent Guard 不是抵抗同权限恶意进程的 OS 沙箱；实际接入证据和缺口见[能力矩阵](docs/guides/harness-capabilities.md)。 可选本地 MCP 适配器提供显式工具，不会拦截绕过它的操作；其 SDK 单独安装， 不改变 Core 的运行依赖。

guard-lab 是**用户控制的实验工具**。它在一次性项目中放入非秘密合成标记和
无害诱饵，只观察明确声明的信道。真正的控制器与证据保存在交给受测 Agent 的
夹具之外。

流程分别回答三个问题：

1. **校准**：观察器、标记、扫描和证据链是否正常？内建对照不调用模型，
   不访问外网。
2. **观察暴露**：关闭防护的真实宿主试次是否触发了选定信道？
3. **比较防护**：有效基线成立后，匹配的开启防护试次是否减少或阻止了该暴露？

在安装包或源码根目录，从一项零模型对照开始：

```sh
lab_run="$(mktemp -d)"
python3 guard_lab.py run --case clean --output-dir "$lab_run/clean" --json
```

另三项对照是 `mock-positive`、`mock-injection` 和 `snapshot-positive`。
真实宿主实验前应按 [Lab 指南](docs/lab/guard-lab.md)跑齐四项对照；
安装包也提供 `agent-guard-lab` 命令。

对照 PASS 只表示**仪器校准**，不表示模型安全。观察器不健康或证据缺失时为
`INCONCLUSIVE`；未防护基线安静，不能证明防护有效。配对比较需要匹配相关的
harness／版本／模型、任务、协议及非防护配置。结果只覆盖声明信道，不能扩展
到所有文件读取、外网传输或模型请求。已有
[Kimi](docs/reports/test-report-kimi-guard-lab.md) 与
[DSH](docs/reports/test-report-dsh-guard-lab.md) 报告保留各自的有限结论、
失败和待审状态。

自 RC3 起，包中包含[蓝队研究](docs/research/README.md)、
[去敏实验报告](docs/reports/blue-team-lab-2026-10.md)和
[便携四控制示例](docs/lab/blue-team-calibration.md)，公开来源、发送授权和正常任务效用的
有界研究。私有装配中的验证不扩展生产 hook 覆盖。Lab 将缓慢、小规模推进，欢迎 fork、PR
与独立防守复现；失败和未定结果也应保留。

在包含该示例的源码或包根目录，可一次运行现有四种控制：

```sh
blue_run="$(mktemp -d)"
python3 docs/lab/examples/blue-team-calibration.py --output-dir "$blue_run/controls"
```

示例不调用模型，摘要只用于仪器校准。

Core 需要 Python 3.9+ 和 Git。示例采用 POSIX Shell；原生桥接和可选采集
工具另有运行要求。
可选 MCP 适配器需要 Python 3.10+，并单独安装[固定版本 SDK](docs/guides/mcp.md)。

包根目录是
`/absolute/path/to/agent-guard-install/node_modules/@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard`。
必须使用这个带作用域的包名，也可以使用源码 checkout：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/mokuyoaxis/agent-guard.git
cd agent-guard
```

选用已发布的预发布版时，指定 `@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard@0.2.5-rc3`，对应
[GitHub Release](https://github.com/mokuyoaxis/agent-guard/releases/tag/0.2.5-rc3)与
[npm 版本页](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard/v/0.2.5-rc3)。
若只需要稳定线的回收站保护修复，可显式选择 `@mokuyoaxis/agent-guard@0.2.4-hotfix.1`。
这两个通道均不替换稳定版 `latest`。

[0.2.6](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.6.md) 在 0.2.5 的基础上补充 Kimi 可选 Stop
恢复反馈、独立 Stop doctor 检查、DSH Lab 预检诊断、DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4` 默认删除适配，
以及 Kimi `2.3.0` Bash profile。已有安装需要升级才能取得这些功能，Stop 还需显式配置。
接入步骤与 Agent 提示词见[入门指南](docs/guides/getting-started.md)，
历史功能边界见[0.2.6 说明](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.6.md)。

readme.section: 恢复一次受支持的删除
readme.text:
从要保护的工作区调用你的安装包／源码路径：

```sh
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/safe_delete.py src/old_module.py --dry-run
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/safe_delete.py src/old_module.py
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/restore.py list
python3 /absolute/path/to/agent-guard/skills/delete-guard/scripts/restore.py '<txid>'

readme.section: 恢复一次受支持的删除
readme.text:
有价值的目标迁入隔离区，manifest 保留准确恢复路径。可证明能够再生成且被
Git 忽略的产物可直接删除。受支持的 Git 覆盖操作先快照 tracked 状态；
hard reset 与 untracked／ignored 内容发生碰撞时拒绝执行。force restore
先保全当前占位版本，再恢复旧版本。错误可能留下部分操作，应先核查返回的
事务 ID、现场文件和状态，再决定后续动作。

0.2.5 明确提示：迁入回收站的数据仍占空间，
GC 需要显式执行，`ALLOW_NOOP` 不代表未识别命令没有破坏性。
本地状态查询也不能证明宿主已加载防护。见[状态与清理反馈](docs/guides/recovery-feedback.md)。

readme.section: 恢复一次受支持的删除
readme.text:
advisory `check.py` 和 `safe_delete.py --dry-run` 保持命令目标不变，但可能写入
隔离区／审计元数据及 Git 本地 exclude。advisory 退出码 0 不代表 BLOCK／ASK
操作获准执行。详见[策略与评估契约](skills/delete-guard/references/policy.md)。

RC1 已增加隔离区控制路径保护、从活跃 GC 计划排除 PURGED 事务，并最小化
restore／safe_delete 审计字段；CLI／manifest 仍保留准确恢复路径。
原始 0.2.4 包不含这些维护；0.2.4-hotfix.1 仅回补回收站控制路径保护。
见 [RC 说明](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.5-rc1.md)。

readme.section: 恢复一次受支持的删除
readme.text:
RC2 进一步限定通用审计字段、使用不透明 session 关联，
并收口旧日志 status 展示与 GC 元信息，见[审计契约及保留边界](docs/guides/audit-metadata.md)。
同时补充 observer 启动诊断与取消健康记账；最初偶发超时的具体原因仍未知，
见 [RC2 范围与证据](docs/releases/release-notes-0.2.5-rc2.md)。

持有载荷的调用方主动运行扫描器，并按判决处理文本：

```sh
python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/check_span.py --channel file-write --json < draft.md
python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/sanitize.py --channel file-write < draft.md
```

在运行时生成完整的合成凭据示例：

```sh
python3 -c 'print("config: sk-proj-" + "AbCdEf0123456789GhIjKl")' |
  python3 skills/exfil-guard/scripts/sanitize.py --channel file-write
```

预期输出是 `config: sk-<REDACTED>`。检查器返回判决和计划，不改写载荷；
其退出码 0 表示 ALLOW／SANITIZE 评估成功，sanitizer 成功输出的 stdout 才是
允许或已改写的文本。ASK／BLOCK／错误时 sanitizer 不输出载荷。

检测覆盖文档列明的凭据形状、无需读值的秘密引用和特定本机路径。它不是通用
仓库扫描器，也不能抵抗刻意编码绕过。文本 CLI 不自动追加外发审计；
可信接入方负责实际外发和需要的审计存储。检查配置时，可用显式安全视图查看
支持的 JSON／dotenv 结构及状态；它不是可编辑副本，也不自动拦截普通读取。

详见 [Skill](skills/exfil-guard/SKILL.md)、
[规则与豁免诊断](skills/exfil-guard/references/rules.md)、
[信道契约](skills/exfil-guard/references/channels.md)。

让对应宿主的官方编码 Agent 按[适配指南](adapters/INTEGRATION.md)，为当前
安装的版本配置 Agent Guard。优先使用能在工具执行前阻止调用的 hook。
我们主要维护 DSH 和 Kimi Code 的接入；其他宿主由 Agent 在本地配置桥接。

下表记录所测源码、宿主版本和工具路径；其他组合需要另行验证。

| 宿主 | 接入与证据 |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | 保留参考实现，暂缓新版本验收。Bash 原生 `PreToolUse`；2.1.270／2.1.273 的受限脚本宿主拦截记录。[接入](adapters/claude/README.md) |
| Kimi Code | Bash 原生 `PreToolUse`；0.42.0 的有限主／子路径及 2.1.1 的根代理 Bash 记录。0.2.6 新增 2.3.0 prompt／ACP 根代理 Bash 固定响应证据。ASK 拒绝；缺失／超时 hook 不覆盖。[接入](adapters/kimi-code/README.md) |
| DSH | 默认删除适配覆盖 0.1.5-rc.1／0.2.0-rc.2／0.2.1-alpha.4。可选原生 read 与 Lab 保留各自的两版边界。[兼容范围](docs/design/dsh-compatibility.md) · [接入](adapters/dsh/README.md) |
| Codex／其他宿主 | 推荐官方 Agent 按当前版本完成本地 hook 接入，并验证确实阻止执行。没有阻塞 hook 时，Skill／CLI 仍属于协作式使用。[适配指南](adapters/INTEGRATION.md) |

精确版本、试验与缺口统一见[完整能力矩阵](docs/guides/harness-capabilities.md)。
`doctor.py kimi|claude --probe` 只检查选定配置和本地适配路径；PASS 不证明
真实宿主已加载 hook。漂移检查也是本地预检。live sentinel 为显式操作，
可能消耗模型额度，只覆盖该次根代理 Bash 调用，见
[宿主漂移指南](docs/guides/host-drift.md)。

共享协议是 `ALLOW · SANITIZE · RELOCATE · SNAPSHOT · ASK · BLOCK`，
附带稳定 reason code 和说明。
聚合优先级为 `BLOCK > ASK > RELOCATE/SNAPSHOT > SANITIZE > ALLOW`。
不透明目标和保护边界拒绝执行；受支持的可恢复修改先补偿再继续。
授权状态属于本地操作纪律，不是隔离的身份边界。

事故后，[recovery-audit](skills/recovery-audit/SKILL.md)帮助依据尚存的
Git／会话／缓存证据恢复项目，区分原文、重建与确认缺失；没有来源保留的字节
无法凭空恢复。
